data.name: SunnySemi LLC
data.boilerplate: SunnySemi LLC is a Tampa, Florida-based fabless semiconductor designer. Its SunCore edge-inference processors and GulfSwitch power-management devices serve equipment manufacturers building industrial, infrastructure and embedded systems. The company designs silicon and reference platforms in Florida and works with external wafer-fabrication, assembly and test partners. Its Sarasota engineering site supports package characterization, application validation and customer bring-up. SunnySemi combines version-controlled silicon specifications with evaluation hardware and application support so customers can qualify components against their own system requirements. Product information is available at https://sunnysemi.example.
data.finance_basis: USD; calendar fiscal years; recognized revenue, not bookings; operating income excludes no additional adjustments and is not net income or cash flow.

data.definition: Trillion integer operations per second at the stated precision; a silicon peak, not application throughput.

Recognized revenue less cost of goods sold and operating expenses.
A company that designs semiconductors and contracts external wafer fabrication.
Signed eight-bit integer arithmetic used by the SunCore peak-throughput specification.
A digital power-management command interface; support is limited to listed commands.
Documented verification against release criteria; not a regulatory certification.

data.capability: 12 nm inference ASIC with PCIe Gen3 x4 host interface

data.quote: Our priority is to make SunCore 1.0 useful in real equipment, not just impressive in a specification table.
